paragraphs: Maya visits IKEA with her cousin Daniel, who is moving into a smaller apartment. An employee {{mask_1}} welcomes them points out the room displays and explains where to find kitchen furniture. They meet a designer {{mask_2}} Maya spoke with during an earlier visit. Daniel also calls his friend, {{mask_3}} recently furnished a studio apartment, to ask for advice. Before choosing a table, they meet an installer with {{mask_4}} they had arranged a delivery. The installer describes the available time slots and asks them to confirm their address.

In the kitchen department, a salesperson {{mask_5}} knows the cabinet options helps Maya compare sizes. Daniel shows her a photo of a chef {{mask_6}} he follows online, hoping to choose a similar work surface. A kitchen specialist to {{mask_7}} they direct their questions explains how to measure the space at home. Maya asks a customer {{mask_8}} she recognizes from her building about the shelves on display. An adviser {{mask_9}} works at the planning desk sketches a layout. She gives the plan to a customer for {{mask_10}} she has already prepared a list of options.

They continue to the dining area, where they test several chairs and tables. A friend {{mask_11}} shops there by chance joins them for a few minutes. The group notices a couple {{mask_12}} are comparing two different table sizes and gives them room to decide. A department manager {{mask_13}} oversees the dining displays answers a question about the materials. A staff member {{mask_14}} has assembled one of the sample tables shows them how its leaf extends. They also meet an interior design student, for {{mask_15}} the visit is part of a class project about small spaces.

After choosing a table and two chairs, Maya and Daniel head to the warehouse area. A technician {{mask_16}} checks the stock information confirms that the items are available. They ask a worker {{mask_17}} they met near the storage shelves where to collect the packages. A service coordinator from {{mask_18}} they receive their delivery details reviews the order with them. Outside, a driver {{mask_19}} is loading a nearby van explains how the delivery team will contact them. Daniel sends a message to his cousin, {{mask_20}} he wants to thank for lending him a measuring tape, and they leave with a plan for setting up the new apartment.
